label_truth_note: All pixel metrics measure agreement with existing A labels; no independent human trail/distractor truth is implied.
ignore_mask: same class_map/weight-derived mask for all three passes; weights == 0 are ignored

coverage_mask.definition: pixel centers outside each source raster's geometric bounds only; in-bounds zero/nodata/alpha values do not extend this mask
coverage_mask.primary_metric: coverage_aware_thresholds; legacy thresholds remain reported beside it

ablation_semantics.terrain_neutralized: zero channels 4:7 in the original [0,1] input before forward
ablation_semantics.optical_neutralized: zero RGB+NIR channels 0:4 at the model optical-network pre-hook, after RGB normalization; terrain branch unchanged
